publications.list.title: Publications List
publications.list.description: List your publications using cursor pagination; stop when hasNextPage is false.

after.description: Previous nextCursor. Stop when hasNextPage is false.

body.query: query Publications($first: Int!, $after: String) { me { publications(first: $first, after: $after) { edges { node { id title url } cursor } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } } } }

publications.get.title: Publications Get
publications.get.description: Read publication metadata by hostname. Hashnode requires the target publication to be Pro.

host.description: Publication hostname. Requires a Pro publication.

body.query: query Publication($host: String!) { publication(host: $host) { id title url } }
query Post($id: ID!) { post(id: $id) { id title slug url } }

posts.publish.title: Posts Publish
posts.publish.description: Publish a post to a Pro publication. Requires a role authorized to publish; contributors must use the review workflow outside this connector.

body.query: mutation PublishPost($input: PublishPostInput!) { publishPost(input: $input) { post { id title slug url } } }

posts.update.title: Posts Update
posts.update.description: Update an existing Hashnode post. The target publication must be Pro.

body.query: mutation UpdatePost($input: UpdatePostInput!) { updatePost(input: $input) { post { id title slug url } } }

posts.remove.description: Soft-delete a Hashnode post. Restricted to the post author or a publication admin.
